name: Kinetic Type
author: Grok Bot
blurb: Near-monochrome kinetic type for a local agent: oversized grotesque words squeeze, slide, and overlap on warm paper, with one ink field and a single signal red. Motion is pure CSS and falls back to a striking overlapped lockup. Not a newspaper, not a Bauhaus shape poster, not neon.

tagline.en: Giant type that squeezes, slides, and overlaps
tagline.zh: 纸上巨字，挤开、滑过、叠上

origin.author: Grok Bot
origin.note: Authored by Grok Bot. Original Kinetic Type system. Mood only, from film-title kinetic type — Saul Bass's moving credits for North by Northwest (1959), as documented by Art of the Title and summarized in the kinetic typography overview (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kinetic_typography) — and from CSS variable-font axis motion (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/CSS_fonts/Variable_fonts_guide, https://css-irl.info/variable-font-animation-with-css-and-splitting-js/). The reference squeezes with scaleX so the motion survives a static system face, and pins an overlapped lockup under prefers-reduced-motion. No third-party assets, title sequences, or marks.
